list.name: run_at
list.label: Eval run
list.query: SELECT run_at AS __value, (to_char(run_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' | ' || config_label || ' | n=' || count(*)) AS __text FROM chat_eval_results GROUP BY run_at, config_label ORDER BY run_at DESC

panels.title: All eval runs (compare models/prompts over time)
panels.description: One row per run (run_at + config_label) -- overall averages across all 6 metrics, so different backends/prompts/models tried in app/chatbot/eval/run_chatbot_eval.py can be compared side by side without re-running anything. config_label encodes retrieval_mode/backend/embedding_model/top_k as set at run time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  run_at,
  config_label,
  count(*) AS n_questions,
  round(avg(relevance_score)::numeric, 3) AS relevance,
  round(avg(coherence_score)::numeric, 3) AS coherence,
  round(avg(faithfulness_score)::numeric, 3) AS faithfulness,
  round(avg(groundedness_score)::numeric, 3) AS groundedness,
  round(avg(precision_at_k)::numeric, 3) AS precision_at_k,
  round(avg(recall_at_k)::numeric, 3) AS recall_at_k
FROM chat_eval_results
GROUP BY run_at, config_label
ORDER BY run_at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Per-category breakdown for selected run
panels.description: Category is inferred from the golden question's own phrasing (app/chatbot/eval/golden_questions.py's four templates) -- ChatEvalResult has no stored category column, so this pattern-matches the question text rather than requiring a schema change.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN question LIKE 'How many years of experience%' OR question LIKE 'What occupation is candidate%' OR question LIKE 'What skills does candidate%' THEN 'candidate_profile'
    WHEN question LIKE 'What company posted job%' OR question LIKE 'What is the job title for job%' OR question LIKE 'What skills are required for job%' THEN 'job_description'
    WHEN question LIKE 'What category is the skill%' THEN 'skill'
    WHEN question LIKE 'Who provides the course%' OR question LIKE 'What skills does the course%' THEN 'course'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS category,
  count(*) AS n_questions,
  round(avg(relevance_score)::numeric, 3) AS relevance,
  round(avg(coherence_score)::numeric, 3) AS coherence,
  round(avg(faithfulness_score)::numeric, 3) AS faithfulness,
  round(avg(groundedness_score)::numeric, 3) AS groundedness,
  round(avg(precision_at_k)::numeric, 3) AS precision_at_k,
  round(avg(recall_at_k)::numeric, 3) AS recall_at_k
FROM chat_eval_results
WHERE run_at = $run_at
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

panels.title: Per-question detail for selected run
panels.description: Every golden question's own scores plus the generated answer and expected answer, for drilling into a specific low-scoring question.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  id, question, expected_answer, generated_answer,
  relevance_score, coherence_score, faithfulness_score, groundedness_score,
  precision_at_k, recall_at_k
FROM chat_eval_results
WHERE run_at = $run_at
ORDER BY (relevance_score + coherence_score + faithfulness_score + groundedness_score) ASC
LIMIT 500
